Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs Docker (apt or yum source), adds a specified user to the docker group, and ensures the docker daemon is running and enabled at boot.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
- name: Install and configure Docker Engine
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    # Set this to the existing system user you want to add to the docker group
    docker_user: ""

    apt_arch_map:
      x86_64: amd64
      aarch64: arm64
      armv7l: armhf
      ppc64le: ppc64el
      s390x: s390x

    docker_packages:
      - docker-ce
      - docker-ce-cli
      - containerd.io
      - docker-buildx-plugin
      - docker-compose-plugin

  tasks:
    - name: Assert docker_user is provided
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - docker_user is defined
          - docker_user | length > 0
        fail_msg: "You must define 'docker_user' (the existing system user to add to the docker group)."

    - name: Check that the specified user exists
      ansible.builtin.getent:
        database: passwd
        key: "{{ docker_user }}"
      register: docker_user_getent

    - name: Assert the specified user exists
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - docker_user_getent.ansible_facts.getent_passwd is defined
          - docker_user in docker_user_getent.ansible_facts.getent_passwd
        fail_msg: "User '{{ docker_user }}' does not exist on the target system."

    - name: Install Docker on Debian/Ubuntu
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"
      block:
        - name: Ensure APT prerequisites are present
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            name:
              - ca-certificates
              - curl
              - gnupg
            state: present
            update_cache: true

        - name: Ensure apt keyrings directory exists
          ansible.builtin.file:
            path: /etc/apt/keyrings
            state: directory
            mode: "0755"

        - name: Download Docker APT GPG key (ASCII armored)
          ansible.builtin.get_url:
            url: "https://download.docker.com/linux/{{ ansible_distribution | lower }}/gpg"
            dest: /usr/share/keyrings/docker-archive-keyring.asc
            mode: "0644"
            force: true

        - name: Convert Docker GPG key to binary format
          ansible.builtin.command: "gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg /usr/share/keyrings/docker-archive-keyring.asc"
          args:
            creates: /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg

        - name: Ensure permissions on Docker GPG key
          ansible.builtin.file:
            path: /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
            mode: "0644"
            state: file

        - name: Determine APT architecture mapping
          ansible.builtin.set_fact:
            apt_arch: "{{ apt_arch_map.get(ansible_architecture, ansible_architecture) }}"

        - name: Add Docker APT repository
          ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
            repo: "deb [arch={{ apt_arch }} signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/{{ ansible_distribution | lower }} {{ ansible_lsb.codename | default(ansible_distribution_release | lower) }} stable"
            filename: docker
            state: present

        - name: Update APT cache
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            update_cache: true

        - name: Install Docker Engine packages (Debian/Ubuntu)
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            name: "{{ docker_packages }}"
            state: present

    - name: Install Docker on RHEL/CentOS/Rocky/Alma/Fedora
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"
      block:
        - name: Ensure DNF/YUM utilities are present
          ansible.builtin.package:
            name:
              - yum-utils
            state: present

        - name: Set Docker repo variables for RedHat family
          ansible.builtin.set_fact:
            docker_repo_os: "{{ 'fedora' if (ansible_distribution | lower) == 'fedora' else 'centos' }}"
            docker_repo_baseurl: "https://download.docker.com/linux/{{ 'fedora' if (ansible_distribution | lower) == 'fedora' else 'centos' }}/$releasever/$basearch/stable"
            docker_repo_gpgkey: "https://download.docker.com/linux/{{ 'fedora' if (ansible_distribution | lower) == 'fedora' else 'centos' }}/gpg"

        - name: Configure Docker YUM/DNF repository
          ansible.builtin.yum_repository:
            name: docker-ce-stable
            description: "Docker CE Stable - $basearch"
            baseurl: "{{ docker_repo_baseurl }}"
            enabled: true
            gpgcheck: true
            gpgkey: "{{ docker_repo_gpgkey }}"

        - name: Install Docker Engine packages (RHEL/CentOS/Rocky/Alma/Fedora)
          ansible.builtin.package:
            name: "{{ docker_packages }}"
            state: present
            update_cache: true

    - name: Ensure docker group exists
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: docker
        state: present
        system: true

    - name: Add specified user to docker group
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ docker_user }}"
        groups: docker
        append: true
        state: present

    - name: Ensure Docker daemon is enabled and running
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: docker
        enabled: true
        state: started
